chapters.d: Your browser agent checks regional shipping lines, vessel movements, and exchange rates before offices open in Honiara. It posts a concise briefing to your team Telegram chat with pending arrivals.
Field officers in Malaita and Western Province send raw notes into a shared group. Specialist bots categorize the data, update shared project documents, and notify coordinators in real time.
Your agent opens supplier portals in Australia and Fiji, fills procurement forms for spare parts, and compares air versus sea freight quotes. It flags the optimal route for your review.
While local workstations and phones are powered down, your cloud computer remains fully active. It runs data transformations, tests software builds, and prepares tomorrow's operational schedule.

faq.q: What are the subscription plans and trial terms for Ceyo?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every subscription starts with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens daily. You link a payment card upon signup, and you are charged only when the trial finishes unless cancelled beforehand.

faq.q: Will my agents continue working if local power or internet goes offline?
faq.a: Yes. Each agent operates on its own dedicated cloud computer hosted in high-availability data centers. Scheduled routines, coding tasks, and web browsing continue 24/7 regardless of your phone or local connection status.

faq.q: Can my bots collaborate inside Telegram groups?
faq.a: Yes. You can interact with your agents individually on Telegram or add multiple specialized bots into group chats. They can divide complex workflows, share documents, and collaborate as an automated team.

faq.q: Which languages and regional terms can Ceyo handle?
faq.a: Ceyo agents comfortably communicate in English, Solomon Islands Pijin, and dozens of international languages. They can analyze local field reports, draft formal communications, and converse via voice or video calls.

faq.q: How does the autonomous browser complete practical web tasks?
faq.a: The agent runs an internal Chromium browser inside its cloud computer. It can navigate websites, research supplier pricing, extract tables, and input form data completely independently based on your instructions.
